name: es30-multiple-render-targets
title: Multiple render targets: glDrawBuffers, glClearBuffer*, integer targets
summary: One framebuffer object with RGBA8, RGBA8, RGBA32UI and RG32I color attachments written by one GLSL ES 3.00 fragment shader; glDrawBuffers mappings with NONE gaps, glClearBuffer{fv,iv,uiv,fi}, integer readback, glReadBuffer and glGetFragDataLocation, all checked against a CPU model of the shader.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.9.2.3 Shader Outputs (fragment output binding, glGetFragDataLocation)
ES 3.0 §4.2.1 Selecting Buffers for Writing (glDrawBuffers, Table 4.3, DRAW_BUFFERi)
ES 3.0 §4.2.3 Clearing the Buffers (glClearBuffer{fv,iv,uiv,fi}); ES 3.2 §15.2.3.1 for the explicit statement that a NONE draw buffer is not cleared
ES 3.0 §4.3.1 Selecting Buffers for Reading (glReadBuffer, READ_BUFFER), §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (RGBA_INTEGER with INT / UNSIGNED_INT, missing components read as 0, 0, 1)
ES 3.0 §4.4.2 Attaching Images to Framebuffer Objects, §4.4.4 Framebuffer Completeness, §3.8 Table 3.13 (color-renderable integer formats)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.8.2 Output Layout Qualifiers, §4.5 Precision Qualifiers, §5.9 Expressions (bitwise operators), §8.8 texelFetch

api.glGenFramebuffers: framebuffer object whose four attachments are written and read back
api.glBindFramebuffer: FRAMEBUFFER target; DRAW_BUFFER/READ_BUFFER state is per framebuffer object (default framebuffer reports BACK, fresh FBO COLOR_ATTACHMENT0)
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: RGBA8, RGBA8, RGBA32UI, RG32I textures attached to COLOR_ATTACHMENT0..3; framebuffer complete, COMPONENT_TYPE read back
api.glFramebufferRenderbuffer: DEPTH24_STENCIL8 renderbuffer at DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT; proven by depth+stencil tested draws
api.glGenRenderbuffers: depth/stencil renderbuffer and a scratch RGBA8 renderbuffer
api.glRenderbufferStorage: DEPTH24_STENCIL8 storage; the glClearBufferfi values are observed through it
api.glBindTexture: attachments sampled by the composite pass on units 0..3
api.glActiveTexture: units 0..3 sampled with texelFetch; panels match the CPU model
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable RGBA8 / RGBA32UI / RG32I storage; contents rendered and read back (immutability itself is not claimed)
api.glTexParameteri: NEAREST min/mag filters make the attachments complete; the composite shows them (via the typed glTexParameter overloads)
api.glDrawBuffers: {C0..C3}, {C0,NONE,C2,NONE}, {NONE,C1,NONE,C3}, {NONE,C1,NONE,NONE} and n = 0: attachment contents compared pixel by pixel, DRAW_BUFFERi read back; INVALID_OPERATION for {C1,C0}, {C0,C2}, BACK on an FBO, COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 or n = 2 on the default framebuffer; INVALID_VALUE for n > MAX_DRAW_BUFFERS; failed calls change nothing
api.glReadBuffer: COLOR_ATTACHMENT0..3 select the attachment read back by glReadPixels; NONE read back via READ_BUFFER; INVALID_OPERATION for COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 on the default framebuffer, BACK on an FBO and COLOR_ATTACHMENT(MAX_COLOR_ATTACHMENTS); a failed call leaves READ_BUFFER unchanged
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE for RGBA8, RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT for RGBA32UI, RGBA_INTEGER/INT for RG32I (B, A read as 0, 1) compared exactly; INVALID_OPERATION for integer/normalized mismatches, READ_BUFFER NONE and an attachment without image
api.glClearBufferfv: COLOR on RGBA8 attachments (clamped to [0,1], 8-bit result) and DEPTH; INVALID_VALUE for drawbuffer = MAX_DRAW_BUFFERS, -1 and DEPTH with drawbuffer 1
api.glClearBufferiv: COLOR on the RG32I attachment {INT_MIN, -1, ...} read back exactly; INVALID_VALUE for STENCIL with drawbuffer 1
api.glClearBufferuiv: COLOR on the RGBA32UI attachment {0xFFFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 1, 0xDEADBEEF} read back exactly; no effect on a NONE draw buffer; INVALID_VALUE for drawbuffer = MAX_DRAW_BUFFERS
api.glClearBufferfi: depth 0.25/stencil 5, 0.35/6 and 0.35/5 select different quads in a depth- and stencil-tested draw
api.glGetFragDataLocation: o_albedo/o_data/o_ids/o_signed = 0..3, single output at location 1 = 1, unknown name = -1; INVALID_OPERATION and -1 for a never linked and a failed-link program
api.glEnable: DEPTH_TEST and STENCIL_TEST for the glClearBufferfi proof
api.glDisable: DEPTH_TEST and STENCIL_TEST restored after the proof
api.glStencilFunc: EQUAL with reference 4/5/6 against the cleared stencil value decides which quad passes
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_size, u_z, u_panel, u_origin and sampler uniforms located; values observed in the images
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit indices and u_panel; the composite panels match the CPU model
api.glUniform1f: u_z moves the quad in depth; observed by the depth test
api.glUniform2i: u_size and u_origin; the output pattern and panel placement match the CPU model
api.glCreateProgram: program that is never linked and one whose link fails (glGetFragDataLocation errors); program for the compile rules
api.glAttachShader: fragment-only program for the failed-link case
api.glLinkProgram: LINK_STATUS false when no vertex shader is attached
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quads from gl_VertexID; all attachment contents derive from them
api.glViewport: full-target and quadrant viewports; quadrant draws land in the probed pixels

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed (llvmpipe and zink captures differ from it by at most 1/255 per channel). Four 128x128 panels: top-left a red/green gradient on a 16x16 checkerboard with darker alternate squares (albedo RGBA8, blue constant); top-right the inverted gradient (data RGBA8, blue/magenta at the top right, green/yellow at the bottom); bottom-left a red-to-yellow/green gradient with fine horizontal stripes whose blue alternates every row (ids RGBA32UI); bottom-right dark blue at the left edge brightening to yellow-green at the top right (signed RG32I). All four panels fill their quarters with no seams or stray pixels.
